source: Ironsworn: COMPANION: HAWK, p. 39 (ironsworn#001); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Hawk. creature. This companion boosts journeys and hunting, helps distract foes, and improves threat detection or defense against ambushes. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
Broken. creature. A savage, troublesome foe that uses ambushes and ferocious attacks, driven to display power and spread pain. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ironsworn: Page 150, Common Folk (ironsworn#005); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Common Folk. creature. Troublesome residents who rely on desperate defense and standing together to protect their families and prepare for winter. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)
Hunter. creature. A dangerous woodland fighter who sets traps, hides, and attacks with deadly shots. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)
Mystic. creature. A dangerous practitioner of old ways who prepares rituals, uses trickery, and tries to foresee enemy intent. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)
Raider. creature. A dangerous fighter who seeks to seize others’ resources and uses intimidation, shield walls, and destruction. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)
Warrior. creature. A dangerous, battle-hardened fighter who maneuvers for advantage and looks for openings. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)
Elf. creature. A dangerous forest being that attacks from shadow, drives off intruders, and may turn the forest against them. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)
Giant. creature. An extreme, intelligent nomad whose sweeping attacks can make opponents flee. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)
Primordial. creature. An extreme embodiment of a natural force that can control elements and destroy through primal rage. [verb alter] (batched reader, unchecked)
Troll. creature. A formidable, secretive collector that can camouflage its skin and attack with claws and teeth. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)
Varou. creature. A dangerous, wolf-like territorial being that attacks at night and can unleash the bloodcall. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)
Bear. creature. A formidable predator that can pin down and maul its prey, with some regional kinds especially aggressive and cunning. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)
Boar. creature. A dangerous, aggressive animal that charges, gores, and circles back to attack again. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)
Gaunt. creature. A fast, graceful mount that can charge and trample when provoked or directed by a skilled rider. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ironsworn: Page 160, Marsh Rat (ironsworn#005); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Marsh Rat. creature. A troublesome oversized rodent that swarms, bites, and can strip a large animal to bone in hours. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)
Wolf. creature. A dangerous pack hunter that stalks, rushes together, and drags prey down. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)
Basilisk. creature. An extreme swamp serpent that lies in wait, uses a mesmerizing gaze, and bites or crushes prey. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ironsworn: Page 163, Elder Beast (ironsworn#005); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Elder Beast. creature. An extreme, oversized animal that dominates its territory with displays and overwhelming attacks. [verb none] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ironsworn: Page 164, Harrow Spider (ironsworn#005); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Harrow Spider. creature. A dangerous giant spider that drops onto prey, grapples it, and entombs it in webbing. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)
Leviathan. creature. An epic sea beast that rams and swamps ships or devours prey whole. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)
Mammoth. creature. An extreme herd animal that forms a protective circle and charges or tramples threats to its young. [verb block] (batched reader, unchecked)
Wyvern. creature. An extreme flying predator that swoops down, snatches prey, and attacks with teeth or tail. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)
Bonewalker. creature. A dangerous, soulless animated corpse that relentlessly attacks the living. [verb law: revival-on-death; also needs soul-state] (batched reader, unchecked)
Chimera. creature. An extreme mass of fused dead animals animated by hunger and pain, attacking with claws, bites, and tearing force. [verb law: revival-on-death] (batched reader, unchecked)
Frostbound. creature. A formidable animated corpse that senses heat and drains warmth from the living with its grasp. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)
Haunt. creature. A formidable restless spirit that manifests, vanishes, and torments the living until its death is resolved. [verb bind] (batched reader, unchecked)
Hollow. creature. An extreme avenging elf-spirit that reforms from surrounding matter and can envelop and suffocate victims. [verb transform] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ironsworn: Page 172, Iron Revenant (ironsworn#005); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Iron Revenant. creature. An extreme force of an unfinished vow, formed as metal armor that draws iron toward itself and cannot be killed. [verb bind; also needs vow-cost] (batched reader, unchecked)
Sodden. creature. A formidable drowned spirit that lures living victims to water and drags them into its depths. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)

source: Ironsworn: Extended Example of Play, pp. 242–250 (ironsworn#008); licence CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
note: Horse companion (Etana). creature. A bonded horse aids travel and combat, can be endangered, and has its own health track and harm resolution. [verb law: protect] (batched reader, unchecked)
Cave Lion. creature. Its abilities improve hunting, attacks, and camp vigilance, with bonuses to supply, momentum, or spirit. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
Horse. creature. Its speed aids travel and danger checks, while charging improves combat and harm. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
Hound. creature. It helps track or investigate, boosts combat harm or momentum, and steadies its companion under stress. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
Kindred. creature. A trusted friend aids moves through expertise, shared combat, or a marked bond. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
Owl. creature. It aids night hunting, ambush defense, ritual work, and survival when facing death. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
Raven. creature. It aids trickery and facing death, and can carry out moves from a distance by taking messages. [verb move] (batched reader, unchecked)
Giant Spider. creature. It scouts, reveals a subject’s deepest fears, and can set a trap that may inflict 2 harm. [verb sense] (batched reader, unchecked)
Young Wyvern. creature. It can trade supply for momentum on a journey, endure harm more effectively, and inflict 3 harm when commanded to attack. [verb add] (batched reader, unchecked)
